Hero.subtitle: Desarrollador Python Full-Stack creando soluciones web modernas y ultrarrápidas con Django y React. Con base en Coimbatore, India.

About.story_1_text: I'm Surya CS — an Full-Stack Python Developer based in Coimbatore, India. I'm a B.COM.CA graduate from Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts & Science with IBM & ITC collaborative training in Python Pandas & NumPy. I don't just build websites — I craft digital experiences.
About.story_2_text: I specialize in Django and React to build modern, blazing-fast web solutions. From dental booking systems to fashion e-commerce platforms, every project I deliver combines beautiful design with powerful functionality.
About.story_3_text: I'm actively seeking to apply my Python full-stack development skills, contribute to innovative projects, and grow professionally. I'm passionate about creating experiences that convert visitors into customers.

timeline.title: Started B.COM.CA at Sri Ramakrishna College
timeline.description: Began my journey in Computer Applications at Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts & Science, Nava-India, Coimbatore. Developed a passion for web development alongside my studies.

timeline.title: IBM & ITC Python Pandas & NumPy Training
timeline.description: Completed IBM & ITC collaborative training in Python Pandas & NumPy, building strong data analysis and manipulation foundations with hands-on project experience.

timeline.title: Indra Institute of Education — Full-Stack Python
timeline.description: Full-Stack Python training at Indra Institute of Education, 100 Feet Road. Intensive program from July 09, 2025 to December 15, 2025, deepening expertise in Python full-stack development.

timeline.title: Launched DentalExperts, CipherApparel & Portfolio
timeline.description: Built a dental clinic management system with appointment booking & patient records, a fashion e-commerce platform with Django, and a cinematic personal portfolio with React & Vite — establishing my freelance web development practice.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Python Developer — Open to Opportunities
timeline.description: Actively seeking to apply my Python full-stack development skills, contribute to innovative projects, and grow professionally in a dynamic IT company.
